result_text:
All four broken default conventions now match their intended files. The new test and the existing related tests pass offline.

Changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`; it is now `(htm|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered.
- **.NET XML docs:** `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by …`:** `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It runs the real default lists against the cases in the task, including the negatives: a hand-written `.htm`, a `settings.xml` without `<doc>`, a `.js` without the generated header. It passes 4/4. `CodeConfigurationTest`, `LogicalDecompositionTest` and `DuplicationAnalyzerTest` also pass.

Nothing is committed.
